A man with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a black shirt, is crouched down to eye-level with a young boy who is wearing a pink baseball cap and a navy blue sweatshirt with a white graphic. The man is demonstrating a funny handshake trick where he pulls his hand away to touch his nose. (2) The setting shifts to a food court area with wooden tables and chairs. An older woman with short black hair is seated at a table with two large red beverage cups and some food packaging. The young boy approaches her and extends his hand as if to shake hers, but then performs the nose-touching gesture his father taught him. The woman smiles and watches him. (3) Back in the mall corridor, the man is teaching the boy a second trick. This time, he holds his hand up for a high-five but instead moves it to scratch the top of his head while making an exaggerated monkey-like facial expression. The boy watches carefully and then mimics the motion with a wide grin. (4) The final phase takes place back at the food court table. The boy performs the high-five head-scratch trick for the older woman. She reacts with laughter and then playfully mimics the monkey-like head-scratching gesture back at him. In the background, retail signs for Mos Burger and Comebuy are visible among other shoppers walking by.
